_instructions: To add a new announcement: copy an entry in the 'items' array, update the fields, and save. Sort by date (newest first). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave 'link' and 'linkText' as empty strings if there is no button link.

items.title: State Qualifier Results — Congratulations!
items.body: A huge congratulations to our state qualifiers from the recent tournament! Results have been posted on the team spreadsheet. Check your emails for travel information and next steps from Coach Kenyon.

items.title: End-of-Year Banquet — Save the Date
items.body: Our annual awards banquet is scheduled for June 5th at 6:00 PM in the San Marin MPR. All members, parents, and coaches are invited. Please RSVP by May 28th using the link below.

items.title: Welcome to the 2025–2026 Season!
items.body: First meeting is Wednesday, September 3rd after school in Room 204. Bring a notebook and a pen. Officer applications will be open through September 10th. We can't wait to see everyone — it's going to be a great year!
